function: Unsupervised DNNs jointly produce the BS beamforming matrix and STAR-RIS amplitudes and phase shifts to maximize sum-rate under minimum-rate (QoS) constraints (p. 2).
system: Narrowband downlink, M=8-antenna BS, K=4 single-antenna users, energy-splitting STAR-RIS with N=32 to 256 elements, direct links blocked; frequency band not stated (p. 2, p. 4).
method: WNet (fully connected) and PNet (convolutional) trained jointly, unsupervised, on negative sum-rate plus a projection penalty; DNN output refined by gradient-descent projection; Adam, 20 epochs (p. 3, p. 4).
data_channel: Simulated line-of-sight Rician channels (factor 10), path loss -(35.6+22.0 log10 d); 90000 training, 5000 validation, 5000 test feasible samples; no public dataset or measurement (p. 4).
test_conditions: Datasets per combination of N, Rmin and Pmax (p. 4); retraining implied (p. 5); tested on 5000 held-out samples with 300 projection iterations versus 10 in training (p. 4).
baselines: Non-learned: genetic algorithm (500 iterations); learned: projection-based unsupervised DNN of [11], same authors; double reflecting-only RIS as hardware benchmark (p. 4).
metrics: Sum-rate, QoS violation probability, average computation time (p. 4, p. 5).
complexity: Measured average computation time versus N and Rmin; proposed several times faster than GA (Fig. 6, Fig. 7, p. 5); no complexity order, operation count, or parameter count.
q1_support: p. 4: "we assume line-of-sight channels" - custom Rician model (factor 10) with a path-loss formula; no 3GPP model, standardized profile, ray-tracing dataset, or measured data is named.
q2_support: p. 5: "re-training of the DNNs may not be required" (future work) - datasets are built per combination of N, Rmin and Pmax (p. 4); no test on a setting unseen in training is reported.
q3_support: p. 4: "compared with the Genetic algorithm (GA) and"; p. 4: "with the algorithm proposed in [11]" - sum-rate compared with GA (Fig. 4, Fig. 5) and with [11] (Fig. 2).
q4_support: p. 5: "Fig. 6 and Fig. 7 show that the time complexity of our" proposed algorithm is several times lower than GA - measured average time in seconds; no order or parameter count.
notes: Area 3: joint BS beamforming and STAR-RIS configuration (energy splitting) by unsupervised DNNs. q3 counts [11], an earlier projection-based unsupervised DNN by two of the same authors that the paper lists as a benchmark (p. 4); its title is Power control with QoS guarantees (reference list, p. 5), and Fig. 2 and Fig. 3 compare the two projection functions, so the reviewer may read it as an ablation and then q3 would be 0. q5 rests on the footnote on p. 1 that says Data is available at the GitHub link; the repository was not opened, so its content is unchecked.
